newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sampoerna down on talk of poor sales.
newsitem.headline: Sampoerna down on talk of poor sales.

text.p: Shares of Indonesian cigarette maker PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna fell 3.77 percent near the close on Friday on expected poor first quarter sales, brokers and analysts said.
Sampoerna fell 375 rupiah to 9,575 rupiah after briefly touching a low of 9,400 rupiah.

"We heard a rumour that Sampoerna was likely to post below-expected first quarter results as the firm was rumoured to spent less than expected on excise stamp duties in the past three months," an analyst with a foreign brokerage firm said.
Sampoerna officials were not immediately available for comment.
Excise duty stamps have to be placed by law on all packets of cigarettes.
